chronicle.title: Hell on the Hegemony lines, night 2: the guns of Verdel Ridge are firing

blocks.h: Hell on the Hegemony lines, night 2: the guns of Verdel Ridge are firing
blocks.text: All day the Concord guns on Verdel Ridge pounded the Hegemony lines, sectors S-F1, R-F23, S-F13, R-F10, R-F9, S-F4 and 12 more. 26 men were hit, 8 of them badly. 10 men were killed where they stood, and the bearers could not reach every stretcher under the shells. The wire there is in shreds.

Hegemony wire in no man's land is down to 24% after 2 days of shelling from Verdel Ridge. In 23 of 45 sectors there are gaps a man could walk through. Wire is what stops a raid before it reaches the trench, and it soaks up the bullets that cross the line. Without it, every post on the fire step is easier to hit. So the wiring parties go out after dark. They crawl out with coils of barbed wire and corkscrew posts that twist into the mud without a sound, and when a flare goes up they drop flat and wait for the dark. Volunteers: comment WIRE under the wiring order on Instagram.

blocks.h: The front stands in their debt
blocks.text: Bastian "Lucky" Vpy, Wendel "Mole" Freddie and Ulrich Jwessels bought War Bonds and put their own money behind the line. Every man in the trenches owes them. The guns stay fed and the front will not forget it.
